description: This file implements checkpoint and wakeup functions for process management in a hibernation context, managing process metadata and preparing for process suspension or resumption.

methods.name: uint32_t HibernateProcess(const uint32_t timeout,const pid_t pid,const char data_dir[],const char volatile_dir[],void ** storage)
methods.description: Handles process checkpointing, associates process id with a metadata structure, and stores it in provided storage.

methods.name: uint32_t WakeupProcess(const uint32_t timeout,const pid_t pid,const char data_dir[],const char volatile_dir[],void ** storage)
methods.description: Resumes process from checkpoint, verifies process id, frees associated metadata, and clears the storage.
